paragraphs.source_en: As soon as the meal was over, Hideyoshi summoned his commanders to council. Toshiie and his son were appointed to the vanguard, while Hideyoshi himself was to depart Fuchū at noon. Fuchū Castle was handed directly to Hori Hidemasa, while Lady Matsu and her daughters remained behind as hostages. The Maeda army set out in gallant array on its campaign against Katsuie.

paragraphs.source_zh: 用完饭，秀吉当即召众将议事，由前田父子任前锋，自己则午时从府中出发。府中城就直接交给堀秀政接管，阿松夫人和女儿们留下来为质。前田的军队英姿飒爽地开始了讨伐胜家之旅。
